payload.title: Qualify V1-min capability grant lifecycle
payload.description: Qualification only for required grant fields, all three admission modes, narrowed executor tokens, journaled time/revocation facts, replay/live-effect distinction. Negative: exact pre-dispatch errors for missing/overgrant, wrong bindings/scopes, expiry/not-yet-valid/revocation/delegation; human approval cannot broaden authority. Preserve V1-MIN exclusions and vb-hk1j8 historical ownership.
